label: Physical Works
summary: Functional morphologies and wearable artefacts reshaping perceptions of the body.
description:
A collection of functional morphologies and wearable artefacts investigating how external structures reshape perceptions of the body.

Each artefact begins with a specific bodily requirement, translated into a material language shaped by studies of form, structure, and behaviour.
Mutation operates as a design logic by which the body is extended and reconfigured.

Developed through an exchange between digital modelling and material experimentation, the artefacts are realised through 3D printing, casting, and hybrid fabrication.
